texts.setting.p1controller.about: What is plugged into the first controller port: a SNES gamepad or a SNES mouse. 'auto' does what the game's file asks for: a .uze file can say it wants the mouse, as uzem reads it; a .hex file cannot, and gets the gamepad. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.
texts.setting.randomseed.about: When the console starts, the kernel times its watchdog timer to make a random seed for games. On the real console that timer drifts; uzem adds a random drift of its own, which this number starts. A different number can give a game other random numbers. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.
texts.slot.game.help: The Uzebox game: a .uze file (the program with a header that names it), or a .hex program as the Uzebox's compiler writes it.
texts.slot.savedata.help: The console's EEPROM (2 KB, where games keep high scores and saved games) at the start, for a project that begins from saved data: a file as Emulator > Export Save Data... writes it (eeprom.bin), or uzem's own eeprom.bin. Every game shares the one EEPROM, each in a block of its own. The file is never changed. Leave this empty to start with a blank EEPROM.
texts.slot.savedata.name_help: an EEPROM file is identified by its extension, .bin.
